title: Rav Chanina bar Avdimi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Nedarim 61b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.61b.4) and [Kiddushin 64b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.64b.14): “Rav Chanina bar Avdimi said in Rav’s name that the attribution is reversed.” In [Bava Kamma 96b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.96b.15) he reports Rav as saying: “The halakhah follows Rabbi Meir,” and it is asked: “Would Rav abandon the Rabbis and act like Rabbi Meir?” They answered: because the baraita teaches it the reverse way.[^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Nedarim 61b and Kiddushin 64b fully write Rabbi Chanina bar Avdimi, whereas Bava Kamma 96b fully writes Rav. Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav. In Bava Kamma the halakhah statement is reported from Rav; the quoted reversal and question are kept with their original force.

[Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1473&lang=en) collects the three transmissions under Rav Chanina bar Avdimi. The consulted Nedarim and Kiddushin give Rabbi, and the consulted Bava Kamma gives Rav.
